attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The amount is said to be enough to buy a small herd of beasts","reason":"The briefing gives no amount or value for the silver offer."},{"span":"the offer is open to anyone, friend or foe","reason":"The briefing does not say who may claim the offer."},{"span":"No claim has been made","reason":"The briefing does not say whether the bounty has been claimed."},{"span":"With both sides holding captives","reason":"The briefing says only the Stonecutter Raiders hold captives."}],"voice":2,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin opens by copying the briefing heading 'News since your last bulletin:', which breaks character, and the dry voice only shows in the 'no heads have rolled—yet' line. It also adds unsupported details: the size of the silver offer, who may claim it, and the claim that the Ochre Hand holds captives too."}
